title: dog10k fetch+map pipeline parameters
description: Per-run, per-sample-independent, batchable stage of the dog10k mapping workflow: FASTQ -> bwa-mem2 mapping -> merge/MarkDups/BQSR -> gVCF -> per-sample stats. One invocation processes one batch of one track (HighPass or LowPass) — see code/01_mapping/2_cohort_genotyping for the cohort-wide stage that must run once over the complete sample set.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define the batch's sample input and where results are published.

samplesheet.description: Samplesheet for this batch's FASTQ runs (one track, one batch).
samplesheet.help_text: CSV file with columns: sample, run_id, fastq_1, fastq_2. Each row is one sequencing run. Multiple rows per sample are merged before variant calling. Must conform to assets/schemas/schema_input.json. Built per-batch from nf-core/fetchngs output by analyses/00_fetch-raw-data/run_batched.sh.

reference_genome.title: Reference genome
reference_genome.description: Paths to the UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0 assembly and associated reference files. All files are available from https://github.com/jmkidd/dogmap.

assembly_ref.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA (UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0_ROSY.fa).
assembly_ref.help_text: All associated index files (.fai, .dict, bwa-mem2 indices) must be co-located in the same directory as this FASTA. The pipeline discovers them automatically by filename prefix matching.

known_variants.help_text: A tabix-indexed BED.gz file. The .tbi index must exist at ${known_variants}.tbi.

depth_sites.description: Sites VCF for effective depth calculation (SRZ189891_722g.simp.header.CanineHD.names.GSD_1.0.filter.vcf.gz).
depth_sites.help_text: Used by run-stats.py to genotype known sites and compute per-sample effective coverage. The .tbi index must exist at ${depth_sites}.tbi.

chunks_dir.description: Directory containing BED files that split the genome into processing chunks (chunks_10/).
chunks_dir.help_text: Expected to contain chunk_1.bed through chunk_11.bed. Chunks 1-10 cover autosomes and sex chromosomes; chunk_11 covers unplaced contigs. Used by DOG10K_MERGE_MARKDUPS_BQSR_GVCF for parallel processing.
